description: Get the per-campaign override of which alert destinations receive its alerts. `mode` is one of `inherit` (no override — the campaign follows the org-wide destinations), `override` (alerts go ONLY to the returned `destination_ids`), or `silence` (the campaign sends nothing). `routing_label_key`, when set, adds label routing on top of inherit/override: each scan also reaches the destinations whose label rule on that key matches the scan's value.
name: get_campaign_alert_overrides
title: Get Campaign Alert Overrides
